name: Pollo AI
official_name_basis: ChatGPTのプラグイン詳細画面に表示された名称
original_description:
Pollo AI turns ChatGPT into an all-in-one creative platform, with ready-made workflows to create, edit, and manage videos, images, designs, music, and voiceovers. Start with a simple idea, a product link, a script, or your own images and videos. Pollo AI proposes a plan, estimates the credits, and carries the project end to end, from first shot to final export.

With Pollo AI, you can:

• Generate any medium with top models. Create cinematic 4K video, scroll-stopping images, original songs, and natural voiceovers with 100+ models, including Seedance 2.5, Kling 3, Veo 3.1, GPT Image 2.6, and Nano Banana Pro.

• Turn one brief into a finished piece. AI video production workflows deliver multi-shot product ads, UGC and try-on videos, brand spots, short dramas, music videos, story films, game trailers, property tours, and launch videos with exact text and numbers, or remake a proven ad for your product.

• Reuse assets across projects. Keep characters, products, scenes, and styles consistent across every creation. Organize your files in a shared workspace that stays in sync with Pollo AI.

• Edit and export in the same session. Arrange clips, regenerate any shot, and add transitions, titles, AI subtitles, and music in Director, then export a ready-to-publish cut as MP4, MOV, or WebM, without switching tools.

• Enhance, transform, and localize any asset. Upscale footage, remove backgrounds or burned-in subtitles, and extend or restyle clips with a single prompt. Reframe for any platform and translate videos into 100+ languages with lip sync.

• Batch tasks and control costs. Run up to 12 image or video tasks at once to compare prompts or models side by side. Pollo AI estimates credits upfront and suggests models for your budget, keeping your project spending in check.

From first idea to final cut, your whole production now lives in ChatGPT. Sign in with your Pollo AI account, no API key needed, and start your first project.
